framework: vanilla HTML, single file (app/index.html), no package.json
fonts: Space Grotesk (display) + IBM Plex Sans (body) + IBM Plex Mono, Google Fonts link (app/index.html L7)
palette: hex custom properties in :root, dark-only by design (app/index.html L11-L40)
spacing: no token scale; literal px values
deploy: vercel.json buildCommand copies app/index.html to dist/index.html
